headline: Helion Best Build
title: Helion Build | Light Bombardment combo | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Helion is the Light melee starter in Aniimo. Build it around two skills. Holy Roar raises your Light damage, stacking up to three times. Its ultimate, Helios Judgment, grants the Ring of the Golden Sun, and with that ring Light Bombardment hits thirty percent harder. So roar first, then dive in with Light Bombardment. Which starter did you pick, Helion or Lunara? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Grants Ring of the Golden Sun
Thirty percent more with the Ring

description: Aniimo Helion best build: stack Holy Roar, use Helios Judgment for the Ring of the Golden Sun, then Light Bombardment.
